name: TelefonSorgulama

search.notes: Per-number pages with user comments. Use the national format with a leading 0 and digits only, for example 05XXXXXXXXX.

steps: Choose the subject Numara Kaldırma Talebi (KVKK).
Write the number and the removal request in the message and submit. The form uses reCAPTCHA, which the human may need to complete.
optout.notes: Türkçe özet. telefonsorgulama.com iletişim formunda Numara Kaldırma Talebi (KVKK) konusunu seçin, talepler 24 saat içinde işleniyor. The page says removal requests are handled first and all requests within 24 hours.
